name: Pineapple, Spinach & Kiwi
desc: A green smoothie that still tastes like fruit rather than lawn clippings.
method: Add everything.
Run Drinks for 2 minutes.
Blend briefly again if spinach flecks remain.
science: Kiwi and pineapple bring vitamin C; spinach adds folate and carotenoids.
note: Keep spinach modest so fruit stays in charge.
